en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing a young woman leaning over a balcony or balustrade, smiling at a man dressed in a military uniform. The man is wearing a spiked helmet (Pickelhaube), which was commonly used by German soldiers in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. The background appears to be a painted studio backdrop, typical of portrait photography from the early 1900s.
